text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days before the debut race.
During joint training with Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it! Dia-chan didn't
pass me, not until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Usually I can dodge past from this position.
Kita-chan seems different today, somehow..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's come over me, I wonder?
choice_data_list: That's proof you're really shaping up.
That's proof you're really shaping up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Does that mean all our training is finally
paying off? Yay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan! This is all thanks to you
running alongside me all this time.
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing! Your debut is finally here.
Good luck, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there's somewhere I want to go before the race. Is that alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where Kitasan Black arrived was the main track of Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"This is the course I'll run today...
My precious debut stage..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm still inexperienced, but even so,
I don't want to show the audience anything disrespectful.
I'll make sure to give it my absolute best—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black bows deeply to the racetrack. Her very first race, backed by all her heartfelt sincerity, is about to begin.
